items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Well I know Manny Perez was a loud, loud man. He blastered a lot.

ctx.x: Sweet like that. Yeah. Who were the loud trumpet players in there, the real blasters in those times?
Well I know Manny Perez was a loud, loud man. He blastered a lot.
Did he play any jazz? All in his way.
